messages:
maria_ng: Quick check — we're prepping renewal for dedicated pool `eu-ded-3`. Can vendor hold H100 units until PO is signed? Need ETA on when the hardware will be available if yes.

vendor_liaison_aws: Hey Maria — we can place a soft-hold for up to 72 hours while you finish PO. For longer holds we need a deposit or signed MSA. ETA for H100 in eu-west1 is ~2–3 weeks on current allocation. Which config (A100/H100) and how many cards?

maria_ng: Thanks. Targeting 12x H100 (80GB) + 8x A100 for burst. If we can get a 1-week soft-hold that would unblock the signoff. PO will be submitted by EOD Fri if no blockers.

cheng_wu: FYI also need to confirm cloud quota and GCE reservations. If vendor hold is just physical, we still need quota to attach. Can infra confirm current quota headroom in eu-west1 for GPUs?

quota-bot: Current quotas (eu-west1):
- GPUs (NVIDIA H100): 16 total, 4 used, 12 available
- GPUs (NVIDIA A100): 32 total, 6 used, 26 available
- GPU instances (regional): 40 used/100 limit

leo_v: Good catch. We currently have 12 H100 free — that matches Maria's ask. But those are shared with experiments; recommend reserving immediately with a regional reservation once PO is in process.

devon_ops: Re: reservation — I can submit the reservation request and tag it to the PO number. Need the exact SKU and project id. Also, if vendor requires deposit, who owns that? Finance or sales? @vendor_liaison_aws any docs on deposit terms?

vendor_liaison_aws: Deposit terms are handled through partnerships; typically Sales manages the contract, Finance collects deposit or a letter of credit. I can pull the standard SOW template and deposit clause. I'll attach a link in this thread.

maria_ng: PO will be from project `redwood-prod-eu`. SKU for H100 is `gpu-h100-80gb-std`. I'll DM the PO draft once done. Can you start a 7-day soft-hold for pool `eu-ded-3` for 12 H100 + 8 A100?

vendor_liaison_aws: Starting soft-hold now for 72 hours (system cap) on pool eu-ded-3 for requested SKUs. To extend to 7 days need Sales approval. Tagging @leo_v and @devon_ops for the reservation flow.

oncall-infra: Noted. Also flagging risk: if experiments spike usage we'll auto-evict soft-held GPUs. Recommend putting a reservation at the cloud provider layer for guaranteed allocation once PO is submitted.

leo_v: I'll start the reservation request with cloud. Devon, I'll loop Finance & Sales about deposit. Maria — if PO slips beyond 72h, we'll need to either (a) pay deposit, (b) reduce hold to 72h, or (c) accept partial capacity (e.g., 8 H100 now, 4 later). Which is preferred?

maria_ng: Prefer full 12 now. If deposit required, Sales will try to get fast approval. If not possible, accept 8 now + 4 later but want documentation of expected ship windows.

devon_ops: Action items: (1) leo to submit cloud reservation (I have project/sku), (2) vendor_liaison_aws to drop SOW + deposit clause link, (3) maria to DM PO draft, (4) cheng to monitor quota-bot and alert if other teams create GPU reservations. I'll create infra ticket INFRA-4321 and attach here.

leo_v: Reservation request submitted: `res-2026-eu-ded-3-12h100-8a100`. Cloud response pending (ETA ~4h). Linking command for records:
```
# internal cloud reservation CLI
cloud-reserve --project=redwood-prod-eu --sku=gpu-h100-80gb-std --count=12 --region=eu-west1 --note="pending PO 12345"
```

vendor_liaison_aws: SOW + deposit clause: https://vendor-portal.example.com/sow-template (internal link). Will follow up with Sales to extend soft-hold to 7d if possible.

maria_ng: Perfect, thanks everyone. Will update when PO sent. :thumbsup:

cheng_wu: I'll keep an eye on INFRA-4321 and the quota-bot. If anyone else tries to allocate GPUs in eu-west1, ping me ASAP.

quota-bot: Update at +1h: H100 available now 10 (2 consumed by experiment X), A100 available 26.

leo_v: Cloud reservation confirmed provisionally, final attach when PO processed. INFRA-4321 linked to this thread.

maria_ng: Closing the loop later today — will post PO timestamp here. Thanks all.
